description:
This 3-bedroom, 1-bath single-family property built in 1954 comes with a finished basement and a detached garage, offering strong value-add potential for investors focused on long-term rental, co-living, or resale upside. Now listed at $115,000 with an ARV of $175,000, this price reduction makes an already compelling deal even stronger, widening the rehab spread and creating multiple profitable exit strategies for the investor who moves fast and executes well.

At 1,007 sq ft, this property makes the most of every square foot, with the finished basement adding meaningful living and income space beyond the main floor footprint. Whether the next investor leverages the basement as additional rental space, a co-living setup maximizing room-by-room income potential, or a premium feature to attract higher-quality tenants and end buyers, that extra finished square footage translates directly to increased returns on the back end. The detached garage further enhances the property's appeal, adding both functionality and desirability for tenants and owner-occupants alike.

Located in Cleveland's southeast side, the 44128 corridor offers consistent rental demand and a strong tenant base drawn to affordable workforce housing. The spread between the newly reduced $115,000 asking price and the $175,000 ARV creates meaningful margin for a full renovation and a profitable exit, whether that's a stabilized long-term rental commanding strong east side rents or a quick flip to an owner-occupant or buy-and-hold investor.

Finished basement + detached garage + price reduction + clear rehab spread = a deal that will move fast.

BUYER TO PAY ALL CLOSING COSTS. Competitive Title. Text/call or respond to this email for showing: (216) 710-3474
